item.title: Self-Hosted Public Transit Data Servers: OneBusAway vs OpenTripPlanner vs TheTransitClock
item.description: Public transit agencies around the world publish their schedule and real-time data using the General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS). But serving that data to riders — powering trip planners, arrival predictions, and service alerts — requires dedicated transit data server software. Rather than relying on Google Maps or Apple Maps alone, many agencies and enthusiasts self-host their own transit information systems to maintain data sovereignty, reduce costs, and offer customized rider experiences.
